name: MQ-135
title: Air quality gas sensor (NH3, NOx, CO2, smoke), analog + threshold
titleRu: Датчик качества воздуха (NH3, NOx, CO2, дым), аналоговый + порог

pins.name: DO
pins.desc: Digital threshold output (set by the trimmer)

notes: The heater needs 5 V and about 150 mA; warm it up for 1-2 minutes (24 h for calibrated readings).
AO reaches 5 V: on a 3.3 V board (ESP32, Pico) use a divider on AO.
DO goes LOW when the level passes the trimmer threshold.
